title: Enhanced Recall Crystal
text: Forge a recall crystal in the assembly bench's center, with three eyes of ender and three ender pearls alternating around it.
Same-dimension travel is free; cross-dimensional travel costs a base 100 mana. The three-second channel still applies.

Like the Recall Crystal, it brings a stationary mount along with its contents and passengers. A safe landing space is required; large contraptions and physically assembled structures cannot travel directly.
